title: SophisticatedStorage issue #928: Issue with Hoppers and Chutes 1.20.1

text:
[issue by Fox536]
Short description:
I keep running into this issue, and I can't seem to nail down what's causing it exactly. This is on Forge 1.20.1. This doesn't seem to happen on 1.21 Neoforge even with the same mods/

So what's happening is sometimes hoppers/chutes/funnels don't interact with Sophisticated Storage correctly.

If I place a sophisticated barrel or chest and connect a hopper/chute/funnel to it. It will not output items and any item that is input into it, get voided. However if I leave the world and reenter it, the chute/funnel starts working normally. A newly placed barrel/chest has the same issue again. The hopper/chute/funnel placement doesn't seem to matter, I can place new chute/funnels and they work, but if I place a new barrel/chest they refuse to work correctly with hoppers/funnels/chutes until I reload the world. It's a very strange issue, it only seems to be happening with Sophisticated Storage containers, normal chests and barrels work fine without having to leave and come back into the world.

I've tried a lot of different things to fix this, but with only very limited success. I thought I had it resolved by removing certain addons but then I realized it was leaving the world and reentering it that fixed the issue.

This is probably a mod interaction, but if it is. It must be a very common mod because I've had it happen frequently in many packs (custom or premade). I wish I knew where else to look but I've tried everything I can think of.

Steps to reproduce the problem:
Place Sophisticated Barrel, or Chest
put a hopper under or
put a hopper above it.
Items in the hopper above get voided, while the hopper below will not pull items out of the barrel/chest.
The same issue happens with chutes and funnels from create.

Expected Behaviour:
Items would be pulled or pushed like normal.

Versions:
This mod: I've had this happen on many different versions but I can confirm the follow versions
----- Soph Core: 1.20.1-1.5.1.2335 Soph Storage: 1.20.1-1.4.86.2131
----- Soph Core: 1.20.1-1.3.58.2078 Soph Storage: 1.20.1-1.4.62.1908
Minecraft: 1.20.1
Mod loader version: Forge 47.4.20

[comment by P3pp3rF1y (owner)]
I am unable to recreate and haven't seen any other report similar to this. So this issue may be common in your modpacks but doesn't seem to  affect popular modpacks at the very least. Do you perhaps regularly add a specific mod into your modpacks that is not commonly used in popular ones?
